questions.a: The story is told in first‑person ("eSa") and the narrator himself is the protagonist. questions.q: Explain in your own words why the narrator says "ikB'kkyk tkus osQ fy, eu rM+irk Fkk" at the very beginning.

A wrong answer that merely paraphrases "he wanted to study" misses the emotional intensity ("eu rM+irk") that frames his entire struggle as an internal conflict, not just an external obstacle.

questions.q: Create a diary entry (50 words) the narrator might write on the night he first enters Nanak Singh's class, capturing his dominant emotion and a sensory detail from the scene.
questions.a: "Night falls. The classroom smells of ink and old paper. My fingers still ache from the day's labour, yet my heart races – I am finally where my restless heart wanted to be.
